brief.summary: Equities were rebounding, with Nasdaq futures up about 0.8% and S&P futures up 0.4%, while Treasury yields edged up roughly 2bp after the prior day's big rally. The curve moved roughly parallel; the dollar was slightly weaker, oil fell on relief that Trump delayed Iran strikes, and credit spreads showed AI-related supply indigestion. The Fed remains hawkish, with officials signaling additional hikes but flexibility on timing; markets lean toward an October hold and possible December hike. The dominant narrative is higher-for-longer rates and AI profitability/valuation uncertainty, offset by resilient consumer spending. Tone is cautiously constructive but fragile.
